payments_source: Invoice2Go (Giving Tree Lawn Care LLC), from the daily read-only Invoice2Go pulls Oct 26 – Nov 9, 2026, plus the confirmations recorded in the Oct 26 pull (payments back to Oct 9, 2026); plus the Nov 12, 2026 full-books annual-payer audit (315 paid invoices) for the verified 2027 annual invoices for Ryan LaBar, Edward Holmes, Aj Al-Jarrah, Josh Caywood, Michael and Jody Miller, Dotti Ruffell, Luanne Schwegal, Patti Morris, and Robert Windsor
payments_note: Covers every invoice those pulls listed — paid or still unpaid — as of Nov 9, 2026. Invoices that were already paid before Oct 26, 2026 and never appeared in those pulls are not loaded yet; a customer with no invoice in this set shows “payments not loaded yet.” Some listed payments pay for work done before Oct 26, 2026. For those nine added annual-payer customers, only the verified 2027 annual invoice is loaded so far; any other invoice of theirs that predates the Oct 26 pull remains part of the pending full-history load.
